relations.statement: No additive map clones all of |0>,|1>,|+>,|-> simultaneously, so the union Z union X of the two clonable bases is not an information observable under the finite cloning shadow.
relations.hypotheses: Restricted to the narrowed finite interface recorded in CT-QUBIT-NO-CLONING-FINITE-TARGET; the superinformation definition is an imported assumption, not a primitive.

relations.statement: cloneZ is trace-preserving on the Z basis.

near_misses.claim: Z union X is cloneable by a CPTP map because cloneZ and cloneX each exist.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Per-basis clone maps do not combine into one additive map on all four states; the no-additive-cloner result rejects a joint clone.

near_misses.claim: The fidelity argument forcing p^2=p for CPTP clones is formalised in Lean.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The fidelity argument and complete positivity are recorded as not formalised.

open_obligations: Formal link from the imported superinformation definition (Deutsch-Marletto Section 7) to the repository's finite interface is not established; it remains an assumption of this branch.
Fidelity argument and complete positivity for the finite cloning shadow are not formalised.
No lemma stating that Z union X is not an information observable has been proved from the repository declarations; the existing no-additive-cloner result is only the narrowed form.
Repository does not claim its finite carriers satisfy Principles I-IX.
Disjointness condition (pairwise equal-or-orthogonal classification) for two information observables is not yet grounded as a lemma.
